declarations.docstring: Every invertible endomorphism of a finite coordinate space is induced by multiplication by an invertible matrix.
Reinterprets an equivalence of linear-map spaces that commutes with invertible endomorphisms as an equivalence linear over the centralizer.
An equivalence of linear-map spaces that is equivariant for invertible endomorphisms preserves scalar multiplication by centralizer elements.
Representations identified equivariantly with pairwise inequivalent indexed simple submodules are pairwise nonisomorphic.
Associates an invertible module endomorphism and a natural number with an element of the relevant centralizer.
The action of the centralizer element supplied for an invertible endomorphism equals composition with the linear map obtained from that element.
